description: This file declares classes and functions related to UDP socket operations on Windows, including socket management, QoS handling via QwaveApi, DSCP management, and socket configuration for the Windows platform.

classes.name: QwaveApi
classes.description: Encapsulates Windows QWAVE API functions for setting packet priorities and managing QoS flows.

classes.name: DscpManager
classes.description: Manages DSCP (Differentiated Services Code Point) settings per remote endpoint using QwaveApi.

classes.name: UDPSocketWin
classes.description: Implements UDP socket operations on Windows, including socket creation, connection, binding, multicast, and QoS management.

methods.name: QwaveApi
methods.description: Constructor for QwaveApi, initializes function pointers and support status.

methods.name: GetDefault
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of QwaveApi.

methods.name: qwave_supported
methods.description: Checks if QWAVE API is supported on the current system.

methods.name: OnFatalError
methods.description: Handles fatal errors related to QWAVE API.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the DSCP value for QoS flow.

methods.name: PrepareForSend
methods.description: Prepares QoS flow for sending data to a remote address.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin
methods.description: Constructor for UDP socket, initializes socket parameters.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Creates and opens a UDP socket with specified address family.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Connects the socket to a remote endpoint.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a local address.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the remote peer address.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local socket address.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket.

methods.name: RecvFrom
methods.description: Receives data from the socket along with sender address.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends data to a specified remote address.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size.

methods.name: SetDoNotFragment
methods.description: Sets the socket to not fragment packets.

methods.name: SetMsgConfirm
methods.description: Sets message confirmation mode (no-op on Windows).

methods.name: is_connected
methods.description: Checks if socket is connected or bound.
